overall_goal: Measure out the required amount of pre-chopped garlic.

goals.description: Retrieve the jar of minced garlic from the fridge.
goals.rationale: The person interacts with the fridge to get the jar of minced garlic and places it on the chopping board.

goals.description: Set up the bowl on the scales, open the garlic jar, and retrieve a spoon.
goals.rationale: The person gets a bowl for measuring, places it on the scales, opens the garlic jar, and fetches a spoon from the drawer.

goals.description: Scoop and measure the minced garlic into the bowl.
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly scoops garlic from the jar, drains the excess liquid, and tips the garlic into the bowl on the scales to measure it.
